word: Words are the smallest meaningful pieces of a language that can be used on their own.
Do you even understand the words I am saying?!
A word is a short conversation.
Can I have a word with you, John?
A word is a promise given to someone.
She gave him her word that she would pay him the money on Tuesday.
A word is a piece of news.
Send word to John that Mary is here.
When Christians speak about the Bible, they sometimes call it the Word.
When you word something, you are trying to say or write it using certain words and to phrase it in a certain way.
The mayor's speech was carefully worded to avoid offending the angry protesters.
woman: My wife is a good woman.
worm: A tube-shaped animal with no legs that lives underground, under water, or inside another animal.
He found a big worm to use for fishbait.
Saint George fought the worm with all his strength.
A worm is a type of dangerous software that can go across networks of computers.
To move like a worm; to wriggle in order to move.
wolf: A wolf is a wild animal, similar to a dog.
wood: Wood is what trees are made of. People use wood to build things like houses and furniture.
wool: Wool is the hair of a sheep. We often use it to make clothes.
work: v
If you work, you do a job, usually for money.
My father works at Microsoft.
v
If you work you are doing something that needs effort.
I worked on my school paper all night long.
v
If somethings works it has done what it was supposed to do.
If my computer didn't work I couldn't type this.
v
How something works is how it does what it does.
I would like to know more about how cars work.
n
Your work is your job.
n
Work is effort it takes to do something. That is, its what makes you tired when you do something hard.
Moving heavy logs takes a lot of work.
n
; Work is force through a distance (force times distance). This is how much energy you used to move something.
n

world: Our world needs to be cared for.
The setting of a group of people.

I wonder if there is life on other worlds.
would: v
Would is used to show your past plan or decision.
He said he would be seeing Mr Moi in Bonn on Monday.
v
Would is used to show that in the past you expected something to happen.
It would soon be time to go home, but I didn't want to leave.
v
Would is used to show that something happened regularly in the past but not now.
Every summer we would go to the lake for a few weeks.
v
Would is used to talk about unreal, unlikely, or conditional situations.
You wouldn't like it if you had to see it every day.
v
Would is used to ask politely for something.
Would you please explain that to me?
v
Would is used to offer something politely.
Would you like to go out for lunch then?
v
Would is used to give advice.
I would go back and talk to him about it.
v
Would is used to show that something is typical, usually when you are unhappy about it. In this case, it's always stressed.
He would come just when we were leaving.
wound: A wound is a cut in skin with pain and blood, a burn, or other similar mark on someone's body.
I dropped a knife on my foot, but the wound was minor, so I didn't need to go to the hospital.
worry: Worry means to feel troubled by, anxious, or uneasy about specific problems or the possibility of unpleasant things happening in the future.
While she cooked the food, she worried about her son who was writing an important test at school.
worth: If x is worth y, x has the value of y, usually in money.
The painting is worth over $1 million.

wounded: (usually with "the") People who are injured or have wounds.
wounding: The act of making a wound.
wonder: If you wonder about something, you think about it because you want to know more about it.
I wonder when they will be home.
You use "wonder if/whether" to ask for or suggest something.
I wonder if you could give me a hand with the door.
If you don't wonder something, you expect it.
I don't wonder you've had problems with that old car.
A wonder is something that makes a person think.

A wonder is something that is amazing.
The Pyramids are quite a wonder.
woo: You may yell woo or woo-hoo to show happy excitement.

wormhole: A wormhole is a theoretical space tunnel that would begin with a black hole and end with a white hole; this tunnel would be a shortcut for space travel.
